options.opa: Early diagnosis, intensive treatment and close control of the disease are essential.
options.opb: Methotrexate is the drug of first choice to control the activity of the disease.
options.opc: The rheumatoid factor is typical of the disease and is a mandatory criterion for diagnosis.
options.opd: The specificity of citrullinated peptide antibodies is very high and has a prognostic value.
options.ope: Biological drugs, such as anti TNF, have revolutionized the treatment.
